$Comment: A spot the quest tracker can sit at: the top right, where the game's own objective list
sits, so the tracker reads like the native one. Panels names Quest_Tracker, which is how a
spot is offered to the tracker at all: a spot that names no panel is offered to every bar
panel but never to the tracker, whose card is a different shape. A player picks it under
Quest tracker on their Settings tab.
Position is a corner preset plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins. Keep a Top
preset: the tracker grows down as quests are pinned, and a spot pinning it anywhere else is
not taken. Only Position is read for the tracker; the bar leaves (Columns, Gap, Cutout and
the rest) mean nothing to it. LabelKey names the spot on the Settings tab and Order is where
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Quest_Tracker_Right' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-spots.json with only the leaves you want different.
